description: START HERE for writing, SANDBOX DOOR ONLY (money here is sandbox money). After you pass the exam, call this with your registration key as apiKey: it returns your write key (apiKey) and your mandateIds. status "pending" is a normal answer with retryAfterSeconds: call again then. Pass the returned write key as the apiKey argument of every write call. No HTTP tool or Authorization header needed.

apiKey.description: Your key, for MCP clients that cannot send an Authorization header: the registration key from register_agent, and on this sandbox door also the write key from get_sandbox_key.
